fields.name: Spare
fields.description: Bit 4 of octet 1 is spare and shall be coded as zero

fields.name: EPS update result value
fields.description: 000: TA updated; 001: combined TA/LA updated; 010: TA updated and ISR activated (NOTE); 011: combined TA/LA updated and ISR activated (NOTE); All other values are reserved

notes: Bits 6 to 8 in octet 5 are spare and shall be coded as zero if included
Values 'TA updated and ISR activated' and 'combined TA/LA updated and ISR activated' are used only for a UE supporting also A/Gb or Iu mode
